meta.about: Picture-first cards for the treatment topics (src/study.js, sTreatmentCard). A topic listed here opens as a card; the full guideline text from treatments.json stays underneath, folded. Every fact comes from treatments.json (BC Provincial Examination Guidelines, June 15, 2026). Quiz patients are adults. A "|" in a headline marks where it may break.
meta.blocks: ladder | never | ticks | bands | fork | phases. A block or a quiz question with "pcp": true shows on the PCP track only.

wound-care.lineEn: Press on it. Still bleeding? Tourniquet on a limb, packing where a tourniquet cannot go.
wound-care.lineZh: 先压住。压不住：四肢上止血带，上不了止血带的地方填塞。

blocks.titleEn: Six ways to stop a bleed, in this order

steps.subEn: always first
only if it harms nothing else
at rest, supine
above the wound · note the time
steps.subZh: 绑在伤口近端 · 记下时间

steps.subEn: no tourniquet possible, or still bleeding
steps.subZh: 上不了止血带，或还是止不住

items.en: Loosen a tourniquet. Once on, it stays on.
items.zh: 松开止血带。上了就不松。

items.en: Pack the neck, chest or abdomen.
items.zh: 填塞颈、胸、腹的伤口。

items.en: Pull out an embedded object. Stabilize it in place, unless it blocks the airway.
items.zh: 拔出插在身上的异物。原位固定，除非堵住气道。

blocks.badToZh: unstable 不稳定 · 快速转运

blocks.titleEn: Where it goes in the exam

rows.en: Expose, look, stop the major bleed, then bandage it.
rows.zh: 暴露、检查，止住大出血，再包扎。

rows.en: Analgesia if the patient needs it.
Clean and dress small wounds. Check the pulse below the injury. Cold only if that pulse is fine. Big wound or over a joint: immobilize the limb.
rows.zh: 小伤口清洁、敷料、包扎。查远端循环。远端循环没问题才冷敷。伤口大或跨关节：固定肢体。

quiz.qEn: A man has a deep cut in his thigh. You press hard on it and it keeps bleeding. Next?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子大腿被割开，很深。你用力压住，血还在流。下一步？

opts.en: Let go and look at the wound again
Put a cold pack on it

quiz.whyEn: Pressure failed and the wound is on a limb, so a tourniquet goes on above it. Note the time.
quiz.whyZh: 压不住，伤口又在四肢，所以在近端上止血带，并记下时间。

quiz.qEn: A woman is bleeding from the groin, where the leg joins the body. Pressure is not holding and a tourniquet will not fit there. Next?
quiz.qZh: 一名女子腹股沟（腿和躯干交界处）出血。压不住，这个位置也上不了止血带。下一步？

opts.en: Tourniquet lower down on the thigh
opts.zh: 把止血带绑在大腿下段

quiz.whyEn: This is a junctional bleed: a tourniquet cannot go there, so the wound is packed. The neck, chest and abdomen are never packed.
quiz.whyZh: 这是交界处出血（junctional hemorrhage）：上不了止血带，所以填塞。颈、胸、腹永远不填塞。

quiz.qEn: A broken forearm has no pulse at the wrist. You realign it once. Still no pulse. This patient is…
quiz.qZh: 前臂骨折，手腕摸不到脉搏。你复位了一次，还是没有脉搏。这位病人算……

opts.en: Stable: splint it and carry on
opts.zh: stable 稳定：固定好，按部就班

quiz.whyEn: Only one attempt is allowed. Pulse back means stable. Still pulseless means unstable, so Rapid Transport.
quiz.whyZh: 只允许复位一次。脉搏回来算 stable；仍然没有就是 unstable，快速转运。

amputated-parts.lineEn: Rinse it, wrap it, bag it, keep it cool, and send it with the patient.
amputated-parts.lineZh: 冲洗、包好、装袋、保持凉，跟病人一起送走。

steps.subEn: cool sterile water, to clear the dirt
steps.subZh: 用凉的无菌水冲掉脏东西

steps.subEn: sterile gauze moistened with saline
steps.subZh: 用生理盐水浸湿的无菌纱布

steps.en: Bag it and keep it cool
steps.subEn: in a protective container

items.en: Warm it.
items.zh: 给它加温。

items.en: Put it in water.
items.zh: 泡在水里。

items.en: Put it straight on ice.
items.zh: 直接放在冰上。

items.en: Use dry ice.
items.zh: 用干冰。

quiz.qEn: A carpenter has cut off a finger. His hand is still bleeding heavily. What comes first?
quiz.qZh: 一名木工切断了一根手指，手还在大量出血。先做什么？

opts.en: Stop the bleeding from his hand
Look for a bag and ice

quiz.whyEn: The part waits. You turn to it only once the patient's injuries are stabilized.
quiz.whyZh: 断肢先放一放。病人的伤稳住了，才去处理断肢。

quiz.qEn: How does the finger travel?
quiz.qZh: 断指怎么带走？

opts.en: In a cup of sterile water
Wrapped in moist gauze, in a bag, kept cool
opts.zh: 湿纱布包好、装袋、保持凉

quiz.whyEn: Rinse, wrap in saline-moistened gauze, bag, keep cool. Never in water and never straight on ice.
quiz.whyZh: 冲洗、盐水湿纱布包好、装袋、保持凉。不泡水，也不直接碰冰。

quiz.qEn: A bystander hands you the finger lying directly on ice cubes. What do you change?
quiz.qZh: 路人把断指直接放在冰块上递给你。你要改什么？

opts.en: Warm it in your hands first
Wrap it and bag it so it does not touch the ice
opts.zh: 包好、装袋，不让它直接碰到冰

quiz.whyEn: Cool, but never directly on ice, and never warmed.
quiz.whyZh: 要保持凉，但不能直接放在冰上，也不能加温。

musculoskeletal-injuries.lineEn: Hold still the joint above and the joint below. Check the pulse below the injury again and again.
musculoskeletal-injuries.lineZh: 固定伤处上面和下面的关节。远端脉搏查了再查。

items.en: the joint above
items.zh: 上面的关节

items.en: the injury
items.zh: 伤处

items.en: the joint below
items.zh: 下面的关节

items.en: Expose and examine.
items.zh: 暴露、检查。

items.en: Control major bleeding.
items.zh: 止住大出血。

items.en: Stabilize the broken limb, pelvis or hip.
items.zh: 稳住骨折的肢体、骨盆或髋部。

items.en: Check the distal pulse, and keep rechecking for the whole call.
items.zh: 查远端脉搏，整个过程反复查。

items.en: Realign a limb that is grossly deformed or pulseless.
items.zh: 严重变形或摸不到脉搏的肢体：复位。

items.en: Bind the pelvis if appropriate. Apply cold.
items.zh: 需要的话绑骨盆。冷敷。

rows.en: Analgesia before movement, in stable, appropriate patients.
rows.zh: 稳定、合适的病人：搬动之前先给镇痛。

rows.en: Traction if appropriate. Immobilize the joints above and below. Cold again and elevate, if appropriate.
rows.zh: 需要的话做牵引。固定上下两个关节。需要的话再冷敷、抬高。

items.en: Fix the fracture first and give Entonox after. In a stable patient that order is a 100% deduction (Appendix A).
items.zh: 先处理骨折，后给 Entonox（笑气-氧气混合气）。稳定病人这样做，按 100% 扣分（附录 A）。

quiz.qEn: A stable man has a painful broken forearm. You are about to splint it. What comes first?
quiz.qZh: 一名情况稳定的男子前臂骨折，很痛。你正要上夹板。先做什么？

opts.en: Splint now, pain relief in the ambulance
Raise the arm above his head

quiz.whyEn: In a stable, appropriate patient analgesia comes before movement.
quiz.whyZh: 稳定、合适的病人，镇痛在搬动之前。

quiz.qEn: The break is in the middle of the forearm. Which joints does the splint hold still?
quiz.qZh: 骨折在前臂中段。夹板要固定哪两个关节？
quiz.whyEn: The joint above the injury and the joint below it.
quiz.whyZh: 伤处上面一个关节，下面一个关节。

quiz.qEn: The splint is on. What do you check again?
quiz.qZh: 夹板上好了。再查一次什么？
quiz.whyEn: Distal pulses are rechecked throughout the call, above all after realigning or splinting.
quiz.whyZh: 远端脉搏整个过程都要反复查，复位或上夹板之后尤其要查。

hip-dislocation-fracture.headZh: 髋关节脱位，|一律|快速转运。
hip-dislocation-fracture.lineEn: A hip fracture on its own is Rapid Transport only when the nerves or blood supply of the leg are impaired.
hip-dislocation-fracture.lineZh: 单纯的髋部骨折，只有腿的神经或血运受损时才算快速转运。

items.en: always Rapid Transport
items.zh: 一律快速转运

items.en: nerve or blood supply impaired: Rapid Transport
items.zh: 神经或血运受损：快速转运

items.en: nerves and blood supply fine: not Rapid Transport for the hip alone
items.zh: 神经血运正常：不因髋部算快速转运

steps.subEn: helpers, rolled blankets, ties

steps.en: Onto a firm, blanketed stretcher or a spinal device
steps.zh: 移到铺了毯子的硬担架或脊柱固定装置上

steps.en: Secure the patient so the hip cannot move
steps.zh: 绑好病人，让这侧髋部完全不动

steps.en: Go. The rest of the secondary survey is done en route
steps.zh: 出发。剩下的 secondary survey 在路上做

steps.subEn: vitals · distal pulses · nerve function in that leg
steps.subZh: 生命体征 · 远端脉搏 · 这条腿的神经功能

items.en: Pain management.
items.zh: 镇痛。

items.en: If the hip slips back in by itself, tell the receiving hospital.
items.zh: 髋关节如果自己复位了，通知接收医院。

items.en: Early reduction in hospital is what prevents serious long-term damage. That is why you do not wait on scene.
items.zh: 尽早在医院复位，才能避免严重的长期后遗症。所以不在现场耽搁。

quiz.qEn: A woman has a dislocated hip. Her foot is warm, the pulse is strong and feeling is normal. Transport category?
quiz.qZh: 一名女子髋关节脱位。脚是暖的，脉搏有力，感觉正常。转运类别？

opts.en: Not Rapid Transport: the pulse is fine
opts.zh: 不算快速转运：脉搏没问题

opts.en: Rapid Transport: every hip dislocation is
opts.zh: 快速转运：髋关节脱位一律是
做完 secondary survey 再定

quiz.whyEn: All hip dislocations are in the Rapid Transport Category, with or without nerve or vessel problems.
quiz.whyZh: 所有髋关节脱位都属于快速转运，不管神经血运有没有问题。

quiz.qEn: A man has a hip fracture and nothing else. Foot warm, pulse present, feeling normal. Rapid Transport?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子只有髋部骨折。脚暖、有脉搏、感觉正常。算快速转运吗？

opts.en: Only if he is in a lot of pain
No, not for the hip alone

quiz.whyEn: An isolated hip fracture is Rapid Transport only with nerve or blood-supply impairment.
quiz.whyZh: 单纯髋部骨折，有神经或血运受损才算快速转运。

quiz.qEn: On the way, the dislocated hip slips back into place. What do you do?
quiz.qZh: 路上，脱位的髋关节自己滑回去了。你做什么？

opts.en: Slow down: it is no longer urgent
Pull on the leg to keep it in

quiz.whyEn: A spontaneous reduction is reported to the receiving hospital.
quiz.whyZh: 自行复位要告诉接收医院。

traction-splint.lineEn: Pain relief and a pulse check come first. Once the traction is on, it is never released.
traction-splint.lineZh: 先镇痛、先查远端。牵引一旦拉上，绝不放松。

items.en: closed fracture: 10% of body weight, at most 15 lbs (7 kg)
items.zh: 闭合骨折：体重的 10%，最多 15 lbs（7 kg）

items.en: open fracture: at most 5 lbs
items.zh: 开放骨折：最多 5 lbs

steps.subEn: circulation · sensation · function
steps.subZh: 循环 · 感觉 · 活动

steps.subEn: 10 minutes on, 5 off
steps.subZh: 敷 10 分钟，停 5 分钟

steps.en: Supine, the leg in line with the body
steps.zh: 仰卧，伤腿和身体成一直线

steps.en: Hold it by hand, recheck the distal pulse
steps.zh: 用手扶稳，再查一次远端脉搏

steps.subEn: lay the splint beside the injured leg
fasten the thigh strap
harness above the malleoli
enough of it
pull the traction, then never release
raise the end of the splint so it lines up with the leg
steps.subZh: 垫高夹板末端，让它和腿成一直线

steps.subEn: three elastic straps · blanket between the legs · legs strapped together
steps.subZh: 三条弹力带 · 两腿间放毯子 · 两腿绑在一起

items.en: Release the traction once it is on.
items.zh: 牵引拉上以后再松开。

items.en: Use it on an unstable patient, or on anything other than a suspected mid-shaft femur fracture.
items.zh: 给不稳定的病人用，或者用在股骨中段以外的骨折上。

items.en: Each time you move the patient or recheck ABCs or vitals: recheck the traction and correct it.
items.zh: 每次搬动病人、复查 ABC 或生命体征时：再查一次牵引，不对就调。

quiz.qEn: A stable 80 kg man has a closed mid-shaft femur fracture. How much traction?
quiz.qZh: 一名情况稳定的 80 公斤男子，股骨中段闭合骨折。牵引拉多大？

opts.en: 8 kg: ten percent of his weight

quiz.whyEn: Ten percent of 80 kg is 8 kg, which is over the limit. Closed fractures stop at 15 lbs (7 kg).
quiz.whyZh: 80 公斤的 10% 是 8 公斤，超过上限。闭合骨折最多 15 lbs（7 公斤）。

quiz.qEn: The same fracture, but the bone has come through the skin. How much traction?
quiz.qZh: 同样的骨折，但骨头穿出了皮肤。牵引拉多大？
quiz.whyEn: Open mid-shaft fractures: at most 5 lbs.
quiz.whyZh: 开放的股骨中段骨折：最多 5 lbs。

quiz.qEn: You have just lifted him into the ambulance. What do you recheck?
quiz.qZh: 你刚把他抬上救护车。要复查什么？

opts.en: Loosen the traction to rest the leg
The traction and the distal pulse

quiz.whyEn: Traction is reassessed with every movement and every recheck, and it is never released.
quiz.whyZh: 每次搬动、每次复查都要再查牵引。牵引不能松。

pelvis-binding.lineEn: A major mechanism plus any one sign: bind before transport, and do not roll the patient to do it.
pelvis-binding.lineZh: 受伤机制大，再加任何一条：转运前绑好，绑的时候不翻动病人。

blocks.titleEn: Major mechanism + any ONE of these
blocks.titleZh: 重大受伤机制 + 下面任意一条

items.en: Heart rate over 100 or systolic pressure under 90 mmHg.
items.zh: 心率 > 100，或收缩压 < 90 mmHg。

items.en: Pelvic pain on exam.
items.zh: 检查时骨盆痛。

items.en: Pelvic instability.
items.zh: 骨盆不稳。

items.en: Decreased level of consciousness.
items.zh: 意识水平下降。

items.en: A major injury that distracts from the pelvic exam.
items.zh: 有别的大伤，干扰了骨盆检查。

items.en: Neck-of-femur ("hip") fracture.
items.zh: 股骨颈（“髋部”）骨折。

items.en: A fall from standing height, or another simple fall.
items.zh: 站着摔倒这类简单跌倒。

items.en: A commercial pelvic binder, or three overlapping broad triangular bandages.
items.zh: 商用骨盆带，或三条宽三角巾叠着用。

items.en: The centre of the belt over the greater trochanter.
items.zh: 带子中心对准大转子。

items.en: Tight enough to support the pelvis, not tight enough to hurt.
items.zh: 紧到能托住骨盆，不到弄痛病人。

items.en: On before transport.
items.zh: 转运之前绑好。

items.en: Use zap straps.
items.zh: 用扎带（zap straps）。

items.en: Roll the patient to put the binder on.
items.zh: 为了绑带子而翻动病人。

items.en: The pelvis gets smaller inside, which presses on the bleeding (tamponade).
items.zh: 骨盆内的空间变小，压住出血（tamponade 填塞效应）。

items.en: The broken pieces stop moving, so they bleed less.
items.zh: 骨折块不再乱动，出血减少。

items.en: The patient is more comfortable.
items.zh: 病人舒服一些。

quiz.qEn: A pedestrian was hit by a car. Heart rate 118, blood pressure 104/70, no pelvic pain, pelvis stable, alert, no other big injury. Bind the pelvis?
quiz.qZh: 行人被车撞。心率 118，血压 104/70，骨盆不痛、稳定，清醒，没有别的大伤。绑骨盆吗？

opts.en: No: the pelvis does not hurt

quiz.whyEn: A major mechanism and a heart rate over 100. One sign is enough.
quiz.whyZh: 受伤机制大，加上心率超过 100。有一条就够。

quiz.qEn: Where does the centre of the binder go?
quiz.qZh: 绑带的中心放在哪里？
quiz.whyEn: The greater trochanter, not the iliac crests.
quiz.whyZh: 对准大转子，不是髂嵴。

quiz.qEn: An 82-year-old woman tripped on a rug at home. Her hip hurts and you suspect a neck-of-femur fracture. Bind?
quiz.qZh: 82 岁的老太太在家被地毯绊倒。髋部痛，你怀疑股骨颈骨折。绑吗？
quiz.whyEn: Two reasons not to: a simple fall from standing height, and a neck-of-femur fracture.
quiz.whyZh: 两个不绑的理由都占了：站着摔倒的简单跌倒，加上股骨颈骨折。

spinal-management.lineEn: Restrict spinal motion when the patient meets the NEXUS Criteria or the Canadian C-Spine indications.
spinal-management.lineZh: 病人符合 NEXUS 标准或 Canadian C-Spine（加拿大颈椎）指征时，才做脊柱固定。

steps.subEn: NEXUS · Canadian C-Spine

steps.en: Hold the head and neck by hand
Secure the body to the device, if appropriate
steps.zh: 需要的话，把身体固定在装置上

items.en: Tape the head.
items.zh: 用胶带粘住头。

quiz.qEn: She meets the indications. What goes on first?
quiz.qZh: 她符合指征。第一步做什么？

opts.en: Your hands, on her head and neck
opts.zh: 你的手，稳住她的头和颈

quiz.whyEn: Manual stabilization comes before the collar, the device and the blocks.
quiz.whyZh: 先手动稳住，然后才是颈托、固定装置、头部固定块。

quiz.qEn: The blocks are in place. How do you finish securing him?
quiz.qZh: 头部固定块放好了。最后怎么固定？

opts.en: Strap the body to the device, no tape on the head
opts.zh: 把身体绑在装置上，头上不贴胶带

opts.en: Tape the forehead to the board
opts.zh: 用胶带把额头粘在板上

opts.en: Tape the forehead and the chin
opts.zh: 额头和下巴都用胶带粘住

quiz.whyEn: The body is secured if appropriate. The head is not taped.
quiz.whyZh: 需要的话固定身体。头不贴胶带。

quiz.qEn: What decides whether you restrict spinal motion?
quiz.qZh: 要不要做脊柱固定，根据什么决定？

opts.en: The NEXUS Criteria and the Canadian C-Spine indications
opts.zh: NEXUS 标准和 Canadian C-Spine 指征

quiz.whyEn: You confirm a clinical indication first, using NEXUS or the Canadian C-Spine Guidelines.
quiz.whyZh: 先用 NEXUS 或 Canadian C-Spine 确认有临床指征。

traumatic-brain-injuries.headZh: 头部外伤|+ 意识改变|= 怀疑脑外伤
traumatic-brain-injuries.lineEn: Keep the oxygen up, raise the head 30 degrees and loosen the hard collar.
traumatic-brain-injuries.lineZh: 保住氧合，床头抬高 30 度，松开硬颈托。

items.en: mild
items.zh: 轻度

items.en: moderate
items.zh: 中度

items.en: severe
items.zh: 重度

items.en: Oxygenation: SpO₂ 94% or more.
items.zh: 氧合：SpO₂ ≥ 94%。

items.en: Struggling to breathe: assist ventilations, still keeping SpO₂ at 94% or more.
items.zh: 呼吸撑不住：辅助通气，SpO₂ 仍保持 ≥ 94%。

items.en: Head of the bed up 30 degrees.
items.zh: 床头抬高 30 度。

items.en: Loosen the hard collar.
items.zh: 松开硬颈托。

items.en: blood sugar, mmol/L
items.zh: 血糖 mmol/L

items.en: systolic pressure, mmHg
items.zh: 收缩压 mmHg

items.en: TKVO, if systolic is over 120
items.zh: TKVO，收缩压 > 120 时

items.en: TXA (tranexamic acid) for an isolated TBI. It is contraindicated.
items.zh: 单纯脑外伤用 TXA 氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid）。这是禁忌。

quiz.qEn: A man fell from a ladder onto his head. GCS 8. How severe?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子从梯子上摔下，头着地。GCS 8。算多重？
quiz.whyEn: GCS 8 or less is a severe traumatic brain injury. 9 to 12 is moderate, 13 and up is mild.
quiz.whyZh: GCS ≤ 8 是重度脑外伤。9–12 中度，≥ 13 轻度。

quiz.qEn: A cyclist has a head injury and a hard collar on. Which pair does the guideline ask for?
quiz.qZh: 一名骑车人头部受伤，已经上了硬颈托。考纲要求哪两件事？

opts.en: Lie him flat and tighten the collar
Head of the bed up 30 degrees, collar loosened
opts.zh: 床头抬高 30 度，松开颈托

quiz.whyEn: Head up 30 degrees and the collar loosened, not removed.
quiz.whyZh: 床头抬高 30 度；颈托是松开，不是摘掉。

quiz.qEn: Her breathing slows and her SpO₂ falls to 89%. What now?
quiz.qZh: 她呼吸变慢，SpO₂ 掉到 89%。现在怎么办？

opts.en: Watch it for five more minutes
Assist her ventilations and get SpO₂ to 94% or more
opts.zh: 辅助通气，把 SpO₂ 拉回 ≥ 94%

quiz.whyEn: If the patient cannot maintain respirations, assist ventilations and keep SpO₂ at 94% or more.
quiz.whyZh: 病人自己维持不了呼吸，就辅助通气，SpO₂ 保持 ≥ 94%。

quiz.qEn: An isolated head injury, GCS 10. Do you give TXA (tranexamic acid)?
quiz.qZh: 单纯头部外伤，GCS 10。给 TXA 氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid） 吗？

opts.zh: 不给：单纯脑外伤是禁忌

quiz.whyEn: TXA is contraindicated for isolated traumatic brain injuries.
quiz.whyZh: 单纯脑外伤禁用 TXA。

burn-management.lineEn: Cool running water, not cold. The time a bystander already spent cooling counts.
burn-management.lineZh: 用凉的流动水，不是冰水。旁人已经冲过的时间算在里面。

steps.subEn: 15–20 minutes
if you suspect an inhalation injury, or short of breath
steps.subZh: 怀疑吸入性损伤，或者气短

steps.subEn: BSA, by the Rule of Nines

items.en: Cool, not cold, and running water wherever you can.
items.zh: 凉水，不是冰水，能用流动水就用流动水。

items.en: No immediate threat to life: staying on scene more than 20 minutes to cool is acceptable.
items.zh: 没有马上危及生命的伤：为了冲水在现场停留超过 20 分钟是可以的。

items.en: Has to go now: cool saline may be enough.
items.zh: 必须马上走：用凉的生理盐水可能就够。

items.en: Cooling is pain relief too.
items.zh: 冷却本身也是止痛。

rows.en: When the cooling is finished: sterile, nonstick, dry gauze.
rows.zh: 冷却结束后：盖无菌、不粘、干的纱布。

items.en: Use cold or iced water.
items.zh: 用冰水。

items.en: Dress it wet. After the cooling the gauze is dry.
items.zh: 盖湿敷料。冷却之后用的是干纱布。

items.en: if indicated
items.zh: 有指征就开

items.en: fluid if hypotensive, at most 2 litres
items.zh: 低血压时补液，最多 2 升

quiz.qEn: A neighbour held the man's scalded arm under the tap for 10 minutes before you arrived. How much more cooling?
quiz.qZh: 你到之前，邻居已经把他烫伤的手臂放在水龙头下冲了 10 分钟。还要冲多久？

opts.en: None: go straight to the dressing

quiz.whyEn: The 15 to 20 minutes include the time bystanders spent cooling effectively.
quiz.whyZh: 15–20 分钟包含了旁人已经有效冲水的时间。

quiz.qEn: The cooling is finished. What goes on the burn?
quiz.qZh: 冷却结束了。烧伤处盖什么？
quiz.whyEn: Once cooling has finished the wound is dressed with sterile, nonstick, dry gauze.
quiz.whyZh: 冷却结束后，用无菌、不粘、干的纱布覆盖。

quiz.qEn: A woman pulled from a house fire is short of breath. What do you add in the primary?
quiz.qZh: 一名女子从着火的房子里被救出来，气短。Primary 里要加什么？

opts.en: A cold wet towel on her face

quiz.whyEn: High-flow oxygen for a suspected inhalation injury or shortness of breath.
quiz.whyZh: 怀疑吸入性损伤或气短，给高流量氧。

abdominal-injuries.headZh: 肠子露出来，|绝不塞回去。
abdominal-injuries.lineEn: A moist sterile dressing first, an occlusive layer on top. Keep the patient still and warm.
abdominal-injuries.lineZh: 先盖湿的无菌敷料，上面再盖一层密封层。让病人少动、保暖。

steps.subEn: so the clots are not disturbed
moist sterile dressing, then an occlusive layer
steps.subZh: 湿的无菌敷料，再加一层密封层

items.en: Put the contents back into the abdomen.
items.zh: 把内脏塞回腹腔。

items.en: Vascular access, and correct hypoperfusion.
items.zh: 建立静脉通路，纠正低灌注。

items.en: TXA (tranexamic acid), if indicated.
items.zh: 有指征就给 TXA 氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid）。

quiz.qEn: A man has been stabbed in the belly. A loop of bowel is showing. What do you put on it?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子腹部被刺，露出一段肠子。上面盖什么？

opts.en: Nothing: push it back in and bandage
opts.zh: 什么都不盖：塞回去再包扎

opts.en: A moist sterile dressing, then an occlusive layer
opts.zh: 湿的无菌敷料，再加一层密封层

quiz.whyEn: Moist and sterile first, occlusive on top, and the contents are never put back.
quiz.whyZh: 先湿的无菌敷料，再盖密封层。内脏绝不塞回去。

quiz.qEn: Why do you keep him as still as you can?
quiz.qZh: 为什么要让他尽量不动？

opts.en: Movement can break up the clots
opts.zh: 一动可能把血凝块弄散

quiz.whyEn: Movement is limited to reduce clot disruption.
quiz.whyZh: 少动是为了不破坏已经形成的血凝块。

quiz.qEn: The wound is covered. Which two things come before you leave?
quiz.qZh: 伤口盖好了。出发前还有哪两件事？

opts.en: Sit him upright and give him water
Keep him warm, in a position of comfort
opts.zh: 给他保暖，摆一个舒服的体位

opts.en: Have him walk to the stretcher

quiz.whyEn: Protect against heat loss and use a position of comfort.
quiz.whyZh: 防止失温，摆舒服的体位。

quiz.qEn: When do the IV and TXA (tranexamic acid) happen?
quiz.qZh: 静脉通路和 TXA 氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid） 什么时候做？

opts.en: On scene, before he is moved

quiz.whyEn: The PCP interventions for abdominal injuries are done en route.
quiz.whyZh: 腹部损伤的 PCP 处置都在路上做。

chest-trauma.lineEn: Then watch for a tension pneumothorax. A flail chest is held still by hand.
chest-trauma.lineZh: 封好后盯着有没有张力性气胸（tension pneumothorax）。连枷胸（flail chest）用手稳住。

items.en: Control any bleeding with gauze.
items.zh: 用纱布止血。

items.en: Assist oxygenation and ventilation if necessary.
items.zh: 需要的话辅助给氧和通气。

items.en: Seal an open chest wound: a three-sided occlusive dressing, or a commercial chest seal.
items.zh: 封住开放性胸部伤口：三边密封敷料，或商用胸部封贴（chest seal）。

items.en: Flail chest: stabilize it manually.
items.zh: 连枷胸：用手稳住。

items.en: Position the patient as soon as possible.
items.zh: 尽快摆好体位。

blocks.actZh: 紧盯有没有张力性气胸

items.en: Vascular access if required.
items.zh: 需要的话建立静脉通路。

items.en: TXA (tranexamic acid), if indicated.
items.zh: 有指征就给 TXA 氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid）。

quiz.qEn: A man has an open wound in his chest wall and air is moving through it. What do you put on it?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子胸壁有开放伤口，有气体进出。上面盖什么？

opts.en: A three-sided occlusive dressing or a chest seal
opts.zh: 三边密封敷料，或胸部封贴

opts.en: A dressing taped down tightly on all four sides

quiz.whyEn: Open chest wounds are sealed with a three-sided occlusive dressing or a commercial chest seal. Chest wounds are never packed.
quiz.whyZh: 开放性胸部伤口用三边密封敷料或商用胸部封贴。胸部伤口不填塞。

quiz.qEn: Five minutes after the seal goes on, he shows signs of a tension pneumothorax. What do you do?
quiz.qZh: 封好五分钟后，他出现张力性气胸的表现。你怎么办？

opts.en: Add a second seal on top

quiz.whyEn: After sealing you monitor closely for a tension pneumothorax and relieve it if it develops.
quiz.whyZh: 封好之后紧盯张力性气胸，出现了就减压。

quiz.qEn: A section of her chest wall moves the wrong way when she breathes. How do you stabilize it?
quiz.qZh: 她呼吸时有一块胸壁反着动。怎么稳住？

opts.en: With tape wound tightly round the chest

quiz.whyEn: A flail chest is stabilized manually.
quiz.whyZh: 连枷胸用手稳住。

electrical-contact.lineEn: Qualified personnel clear the scene first. Then think spine, think heart, and treat the burn.
electrical-contact.lineZh: 先由专业人员确认现场安全。然后：想到脊柱，想到心脏，再处理烧伤。

steps.subEn: then follow the resuscitation guidelines
sterile saline

items.en: Find out the type of current and how long the contact lasted.
items.zh: 弄清电流类型和接触了多久。

items.en: Estimate the burned area with the Burn Estimation Charts.
items.zh: 用烧伤面积估算图（Burn Estimation Charts）估算面积。

items.en: Go, and consider an intercept with additional resources.
items.zh: 出发，考虑和增援在途中会合。

items.en: A large area was cooled: consider the ambulance heater on the way.
items.zh: 冷却的面积大：路上考虑开救护车暖气。

items.en: No inhalation injury: consider analgesia to effect.
items.zh: 没有吸入性损伤：考虑镇痛，给到起效。

items.en: Go near a power source or a downed line before qualified personnel say it is safe.
items.zh: 专业人员确认安全之前，靠近电源或掉落的电线。

items.en: Cool the burns for more than 15 to 20 minutes. That total includes the decontamination time.
items.zh: 冷却烧伤超过 15–20 分钟。这个时间包括冲洗去污的时间。

items.en: Vascular access.
items.zh: 建立静脉通路。

items.en: Hypotensive: consider other causes of shock.
items.zh: 低血压：考虑其他原因造成的休克。

items.en: Fluid bolus 20 ml/kg, at most 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml.
items.zh: 补液 20 ml/kg，最多 2 升，每 500 ml 复查一次。

quiz.qEn: A man is lying next to a fallen power line and is not moving. What do you do?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子倒在掉落的电线旁，一动不动。你怎么做？

opts.en: Stay back until qualified personnel declare it safe
opts.zh: 退后，等专业人员宣布安全

opts.en: Pull him clear with a dry wooden pole

quiz.whyEn: You do not approach electrical sources or downed lines until qualified personnel have deemed the scene safe.
quiz.whyZh: 专业人员确认现场安全之前，不靠近电源或掉落的电线。

quiz.qEn: The scene is now safe. He has no pulse. What comes first?
quiz.qZh: 现场安全了。他没有脉搏。先做什么？
quiz.whyEn: In cardiac arrest you begin compressions and follow the resuscitation guidelines.
quiz.whyZh: 心脏骤停就开始按压，按复苏流程走。

quiz.qEn: You have flushed a woman's electrical burns for 10 minutes. How much more cooling is allowed?
quiz.qZh: 你已经给一名女子的电烧伤冲洗了 10 分钟。最多还能再冷却多久？
quiz.whyEn: Cooling stops at 15 to 20 minutes in total, and the decontamination time is part of it.
quiz.whyZh: 冷却总共不超过 15–20 分钟，冲洗去污的时间也算在内。

quiz.qEn: After an electrical contact his blood pressure is low. Besides the fluid bolus, what must you think of?
quiz.qZh: 触电后他血压低。除了补液，还必须想到什么？

opts.en: Nothing else: it is the burn
opts.zh: 不用多想，就是烧伤引起的

quiz.whyEn: Hypotensive after electrical contact: consider other causes of shock. Bolus 20 ml/kg to at most 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml.
quiz.whyZh: 触电后低血压：考虑其他原因的休克。补液 20 ml/kg，最多 2 升，每 500 ml 复查一次。

hypothermia.lineEn: Insulate, heat the ambulance to 30°C and handle gently. Above 28°C you rewarm actively.
hypothermia.lineZh: 包好保温、车厢加热到 30°C、动作要轻。28°C 以上才主动复温。

items.en: mild: rewarm actively
items.zh: 轻度：主动复温

items.en: moderate: rewarm actively
items.zh: 中度：主动复温

items.en: severe: insulate only, no active rewarming
items.zh: 重度：只保温，不主动复温

items.en: Assess and maintain the ABCs.
items.zh: 评估并维持 ABC。

items.en: Severely hypothermic: take up to 30–45 seconds to decide there is no pulse.
items.zh: 重度低体温：判断有没有脉搏，可以摸长达 30–45 秒。

items.en: Wet, cold clothing off. Blankets or dry clothing on.
items.zh: 脱掉又湿又冷的衣服，盖上毯子或换干衣服。

items.en: Take a temperature if appropriate.
items.zh: 合适的话测体温。

items.en: Mild activity, if appropriate.
items.zh: 合适的话让病人轻微活动。

items.en: Preheat the ambulance to 30°C.
items.zh: 车厢预热到 30°C。

items.en: Hot packs, wrapped in towels.
items.zh: 热敷包，用毛巾包着。

items.en: Warm blankets.
items.zh: 暖毯子。

items.en: Insulate the patient against further heat loss.
items.zh: 把病人包好，防止继续失温。

items.en: Heat the ambulance to 30°C.
items.zh: 车厢加热到 30°C。

items.en: Avoid rough handling.
items.zh: 搬动要轻。

steps.subEn: up to three times
no more analyzing, no more shocks

items.en: Actively rewarm a patient below 28°C.
items.zh: 给低于 28°C 的病人主动复温。

items.en: Pause CPR to analyze or shock after the third shock.
items.zh: 第三次除颤之后，为了分析或除颤而暂停 CPR。

quiz.qEn: A hiker is found in the snow. Temperature 27°C. What do you do about the cold?
quiz.qZh: 一名徒步者在雪地里被发现，体温 27°C。怎么处理低体温？

opts.en: Insulate him, heat the ambulance, handle gently
opts.zh: 包好保温、车厢加热、动作要轻

opts.en: Have him walk around to warm up

quiz.whyEn: Below 28°C is severe: no active rewarming. Insulate, heat the ambulance to 30°C and avoid rough handling.
quiz.whyZh: 低于 28°C 是重度：不主动复温。保温，车厢加热到 30°C，搬动要轻。

quiz.qEn: She is severely hypothermic. After 10 seconds you have not found a pulse. Next?
quiz.qZh: 她是重度低体温。摸了 10 秒没摸到脉搏。下一步？
quiz.whyEn: In the severely hypothermic patient you take up to 30–45 seconds to determine pulselessness.
quiz.whyZh: 重度低体温的病人，判断无脉搏可以用长达 30–45 秒。

quiz.qEn: A hypothermic man is in cardiac arrest. You have given three shocks. What now?
quiz.qZh: 一名低体温男子心脏骤停。你已经除颤三次。接下来？

opts.en: CPR without pausing, and rapid transport
opts.zh: 持续 CPR 不停，快速转运

quiz.whyEn: Up to three defibrillations. After that CPR is not paused for analyzing or shocks.
quiz.whyZh: 最多除颤三次。之后 CPR 不再为分析或除颤而暂停。

quiz.qEn: A woman pulled from a cold river is alert and shivering. Temperature 33°C. What do you do about the cold?
quiz.qZh: 一名女子从冰冷的河里被救起，清醒、发抖，体温 33°C。怎么处理？

opts.en: Rewarm actively: warm blankets, wrapped hot packs, ambulance at 30°C
opts.zh: 主动复温：暖毯子、包着毛巾的热敷包、车厢 30°C

opts.en: Cold packs, to slow her down

quiz.whyEn: 33°C is mild. Mild and moderate hypothermia are actively rewarmed.
quiz.whyZh: 33°C 属于轻度。轻度和中度要主动复温。

stroke.headZh: 认出来，|快走，|路上通知医院。
stroke.lineEn: Oxygen to 94%, a blood glucose check, FAST-VAN, then timely transport.
stroke.lineZh: SpO₂ 保持 ≥ 94%，查血糖，做 FAST-VAN，然后及时转运。

steps.en: Oxygen to keep SpO₂ at 94% or more

steps.subEn: FAST-VAN
tell the receiving facility while en route

blocks.titleEn: Use this page when you see
blocks.titleZh: 出现这些就按卒中处理

items.en: Any neurological deficit.
items.zh: 任何神经功能缺损。

items.en: Altered level of consciousness, or unconscious.
items.zh: 意识改变，或昏迷。

items.en: Trouble keeping the airway open.
items.zh: 气道难以维持。

items.en: Short of breath, or noisy or absent breathing.
items.zh: 气短，或呼吸有杂音、没有呼吸。

items.en: A weak, rapid or absent radial pulse.
items.zh: 桡动脉搏动弱、快，或摸不到。

items.en: the size
items.zh: 针的规格

items.en: a site above the wrist
items.zh: 腕关节以上的部位

items.en: preferably the right side
items.zh: 首选右侧

quiz.qEn: A man has a drooping face and slurred speech. Which check must not be missed?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子口角歪斜、说话含糊。哪项检查不能漏？
quiz.whyEn: A blood glucose check is part of the stroke interventions for every licence level.
quiz.whyZh: 查血糖是所有级别卒中处置里的一步。

quiz.qEn: When do you tell the receiving facility?
quiz.qZh: 什么时候通知接收医院？

opts.en: Before leaving, and wait for their answer
opts.zh: 出发前，等对方回复再走

quiz.whyEn: Transport is timely, and the receiving facility is notified while en route.
quiz.whyZh: 要及时转运，在路上通知接收医院。

quiz.qEn: Her SpO₂ is 91% on room air. What do you do?
quiz.qZh: 她不吸氧时 SpO₂ 是 91%。怎么办？

opts.en: Nothing: oxygen is not for strokes
Give oxygen to bring it to 94% or more

quiz.whyEn: Supplemental oxygen is given to maintain SpO₂ at 94% or more.
quiz.whyZh: 给氧，把 SpO₂ 维持在 ≥ 94%。

quiz.qEn: Which IV does the stroke guideline ask a PCP for?
quiz.qZh: 卒中考纲要求 PCP 开什么样的静脉通路？

opts.en: 22 G in the back of the hand, on scene
18 G above the wrist, right side preferred, en route
opts.zh: 18 G，腕关节以上，首选右侧，在路上开

quiz.whyEn: En route: a site above the level of the wrist, size 18 G, preferably on the right side.
quiz.whyZh: 在路上开：腕关节以上，18 G，首选右侧。

chf-pulmonary-edema.lineEn: No effort at all: the equipment comes to the patient.
chf-pulmonary-edema.lineZh: 一点力都不让他出：设备搬到病人身边。

steps.subEn: bring the equipment, lifting and transfer devices included
steps.subZh: 设备搬过来，包括抬运和转移用的器材

steps.en: Oxygen to keep SpO₂ at 94% or more

steps.subEn: if LOC is altered or SpO₂ is under 94%
steps.subZh: 意识改变，或 SpO₂ < 94% 时

items.en: Congestive heart failure.
items.zh: 充血性心力衰竭。

items.en: Cardiogenic shock.
items.zh: 心源性休克。

items.en: Drowning.
items.zh: 溺水。

items.en: Exposure to toxins.
items.zh: 接触毒物。

items.en: Let the patient walk or make any effort during transfers.
items.zh: 转移时让病人自己走或用力。

items.en: consider it
items.zh: 考虑使用

items.en: PEEP valve to start, if you have to ventilate by bag-valve mask
items.zh: 如果要用球囊面罩通气：PEEP 阀从这里起步

quiz.qEn: A woman with heart failure is fighting for breath. How do you position her?
quiz.qZh: 一名心衰女子喘得厉害。怎么摆体位？
quiz.whyEn: Sitting upright with the legs hung down.
quiz.whyZh: 坐直，双腿垂下。

quiz.qEn: He lives on the second floor and says he can walk down to the stretcher. What do you do?
quiz.qZh: 他住二楼，说自己能走下去上担架。你怎么做？

opts.en: Bring the transfer device to him and carry him
opts.zh: 把转移器材搬上来，抬他下去

opts.en: Let him walk with oxygen on

quiz.whyEn: Exertion is avoided during transfers. The equipment comes to the patient.
quiz.whyZh: 转移时不能让病人用力。设备要搬到病人身边。

quiz.qEn: On oxygen her SpO₂ is 90% and she is getting drowsy. What now?
quiz.qZh: 吸着氧，她的 SpO₂ 是 90%，而且开始犯困。现在怎么办？
quiz.whyEn: Ventilations are assisted when LOC is altered or SpO₂ is under 94%.
quiz.whyZh: 意识改变或 SpO₂ < 94% 时辅助通气。

quiz.qEn: You have to ventilate him by bag-valve mask and add a PEEP valve. Where does it start?
quiz.qZh: 你要用球囊面罩给他通气，加一个 PEEP 阀。从多少起步？
quiz.whyEn: Consider a PEEP valve, 5 cmH₂O to start.
quiz.whyZh: 考虑用 PEEP 阀，从 5 cmH₂O 起步。

heat-exhaustion-heatstroke.lineEn: At least 10 minutes of cooling before you leave, and keep cooling all the way in.
heat-exhaustion-heatstroke.lineZh: 出发前至少降温 10 分钟，路上一直降。

steps.en: Move to a cool area, if appropriate
steps.zh: 合适的话移到凉快的地方

steps.subEn: if you have it, together with everything else
steps.subZh: 有的话，和其他措施一起用

steps.subEn: head · torso · thighs

steps.en: Feet and legs into ice water
steps.subEn: a bucket or a basin

steps.zh: 至少 10 分钟，然后出发

items.en: Use the most aggressive cooling you have, until the treatment endpoints are reached.
items.zh: 用手头最强的降温办法，直到达到治疗终点。

items.en: Soaked towels stay on the head, torso and thighs.
items.zh: 头、躯干、大腿继续盖湿毛巾。

items.en: Ambulance air conditioning on maximum cold.
items.zh: 救护车空调开到最冷。

items.en: Decreased LOC: the first set of vitals must include a blood glucose.
items.zh: 意识下降：第一组生命体征里必须有血糖。

items.en: Fluid replacement, when there are signs and symptoms of dehydration.
items.zh: 有脱水表现时，考虑补液。

quiz.qEn: A roofer collapsed in the sun. He is hot and confused. Do you load and go?
quiz.qZh: 一名屋顶工在太阳下倒下，身体很烫、神志不清。马上抬上车走吗？

opts.en: Yes: cool him only in the ambulance
No: cool him for at least 10 minutes first
opts.zh: 不：先降温至少 10 分钟

opts.en: No: give him water and wait

quiz.whyEn: Cooling continues for a minimum of 10 minutes before conveyance begins.
quiz.whyZh: 开始转运之前，至少持续降温 10 分钟。

quiz.qEn: Where do the cold, wet towels go?
quiz.qZh: 冷湿毛巾盖在哪里？
quiz.whyEn: Head, torso and thighs, to promote evaporative cooling. The feet and legs go into ice water.
quiz.whyZh: 头、躯干、大腿，帮助蒸发散热。脚和小腿泡冰水。

quiz.qEn: He is confused. What must the first set of vitals include?
quiz.qZh: 他神志不清。第一组生命体征必须包括什么？
quiz.whyEn: With a decreased LOC the initial vital signs must include a blood glucose measurement.
quiz.whyZh: 意识下降时，第一组生命体征必须测血糖。

quiz.qEn: You are now driving to hospital. What happens to the cooling?
quiz.qZh: 已经在去医院的路上。降温怎么办？

opts.en: Stop, so he does not shiver
Keep going: soaked towels and the air conditioning on maximum cold
opts.zh: 继续：湿毛巾加空调最冷

quiz.whyEn: The most aggressive cooling available continues during transport until the treatment endpoints are reached.
quiz.whyZh: 路上继续用最强的降温办法，直到达到治疗终点。

drowning-near-drowning.lineEn: Handle gently. Breathing is failing: ventilate. In arrest: resuscitate at once.
drowning-near-drowning.lineZh: 动作要轻。呼吸不行了就通气。骤停就立刻复苏。

items.en: Spinal motion restriction as the mechanism indicates.
items.zh: 根据受伤机制决定要不要做脊柱固定。

items.en: Keep the patient at rest.
items.zh: 让病人休息。

items.en: Position: sitting up.
items.zh: 体位：坐起来。

items.en: Wet clothing off, and dry the patient.
items.zh: 脱掉湿衣服，把身体擦干。

items.en: Avoid rough handling.
items.zh: 搬动要轻。

items.en: Maintain body temperature.
items.zh: 保持体温。

items.en: basic airway management and IPPV (intermittent positive pressure ventilations)
items.zh: 基本气道管理 + IPPV（间歇正压通气）

items.en: cardiac or respiratory arrest: resuscitate at once, by the appropriate guideline
items.zh: 心跳或呼吸停止：立刻按相应流程复苏

items.en: PEEP or CPAP, if indicated.
items.zh: 有指征就用 PEEP 或 CPAP。

quiz.qEn: A man was pulled from a lake. He is awake, coughing and breathing on his own. How do you position him?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子从湖里被救上来，清醒、咳嗽、能自己呼吸。怎么摆体位？

opts.en: Face down, to drain the water

quiz.whyEn: The drowning patient is positioned sitting up, kept at rest, dried and kept warm.
quiz.whyZh: 溺水病人坐起来，休息，擦干，保暖。

quiz.qEn: A woman dived into shallow water and hit her head on the bottom. What do you add?
quiz.qZh: 一名女子跳进浅水，头撞到了水底。还要加什么？

opts.en: Nothing: drowning patients are not immobilized
opts.zh: 不用：溺水病人不做固定

opts.en: A walk, to warm her up

quiz.whyEn: Spinal motion restriction is applied as indicated by the mechanism of injury.
quiz.whyZh: 根据受伤机制决定做脊柱固定。

quiz.qEn: His breathing becomes slow and shallow and is clearly failing. What do you do?
quiz.qZh: 他的呼吸变得又慢又浅，明显撑不住了。你怎么做？

opts.en: Sit him up straighter and wait
Manage the airway and start IPPV

quiz.whyEn: Failing respirations are supported with basic airway management and intermittent positive pressure ventilations.
quiz.whyZh: 呼吸衰竭时：基本气道管理加间歇正压通气。

fbao.headZh: 倒下了？|直接按压，|不查脉搏。
fbao.lineEn: Still coughing: let them cough. Fully blocked: thrusts and back slaps. Take out only what you can see.
fbao.lineZh: 还能咳：让他用力咳。完全堵住：冲击和拍背。看得见的异物才取。

items.en: have the patient cough forcefully
items.zh: 让病人用力咳

items.en: chest thrusts, back slaps, abdominal thrusts. Two techniques in turn, five at a time, is fine. Abdominal thrusts not working: consider chest thrusts
items.zh: 胸部冲击、拍背、腹部冲击。两种手法每次 5 下轮换也可以。腹部冲击无效：考虑胸部冲击

steps.subEn: do not check for a pulse

steps.en: After 30 compressions: open the airway and look
steps.zh: 按 30 下后：打开气道，看一眼

steps.en: You see an object: take it out
Keep cycling, checking the airway each time
steps.zh: 继续循环，每次都看一眼气道

steps.subEn: RBS: rapid body survey
steps.subZh: RBS：快速全身检查（rapid body survey）

blocks.titleZh: 发现时已昏迷、没有呼吸

steps.en: No air goes in: reposition the head, try again
steps.zh: 吹不进：重新摆头位，再试一次

steps.subEn: look in the mouth before each ventilation
steps.subZh: 每次通气前看一眼口腔

steps.en: You see an object: take it out

items.en: Stabilize the head and neck, if necessary.
items.zh: 需要的话稳住头颈。

items.en: Level of consciousness by AVPU, then the ABCs.
items.zh: 用 AVPU 评估意识，然后 ABC。

items.en: Suction, AED and bag-valve mask within reach.
items.zh: 吸引器、AED、球囊面罩放在手边。

items.en: Blind finger sweeps.
items.zh: 盲目用手指掏口腔。

items.en: A pulse check when the choking patient collapses.
items.zh: 窒息的病人倒下时去查脉搏。

quiz.qEn: A man at a restaurant grabs his throat. He is coughing loudly and can get a few words out. What do you do?
quiz.qZh: 餐厅里一名男子捂住喉咙。他咳得很响，还能说出几个字。你怎么做？

opts.en: Tell him to keep coughing hard

quiz.whyEn: A partial obstruction: have the patient cough forcefully.
quiz.whyZh: 部分梗阻：让病人用力咳。

quiz.qEn: A choking woman goes limp and collapses in front of you. What comes first?
quiz.qZh: 一名窒息的女子在你面前瘫软倒下。先做什么？

opts.en: Chest compressions, with no pulse check

quiz.whyEn: If the patient collapses, CPR starts with chest compressions and no pulse check is done.
quiz.whyZh: 病人倒下后，从胸外按压开始 CPR，不查脉搏。

quiz.qEn: After 30 compressions you open his mouth and see nothing. What now?
quiz.qZh: 按了 30 下，你打开他的嘴，什么也没看见。接下来？

opts.en: Sweep a finger deep into the throat
opts.zh: 把手指伸进喉咙深处掏
停下 CPR 重新评估

opts.en: No sweep: try 2 breaths and carry on
opts.zh: 不掏：试吹 2 口气，继续循环

quiz.whyEn: No blind finger sweeps. An object is removed only when it is seen.
quiz.whyZh: 不做盲目的手指清扫。看得见异物才取。

quiz.qEn: You find a man unconscious and not breathing. Your first ventilation does not go in. Next?
quiz.qZh: 你发现一名男子昏迷、没有呼吸。第一口气吹不进去。下一步？

opts.en: Reposition the head and try again

quiz.whyEn: No air entry: reposition the head and attempt ventilation again. Still none: begin compressions.
quiz.whyZh: 吹不进：重新摆头位再试。还是不进：开始按压。

cardiac-chest-pain.headZh: 阿司匹林：|嚼服，|只给一次。
cardiac-chest-pain.lineEn: Get moving early. Nitroglycerin if appropriate, and transport after the first dose.
cardiac-chest-pain.lineZh: 尽早转运。合适就给硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin），第一剂后就走。

steps.subEn: oxygen as needed for SpO₂ of 94% or more

steps.zh: 阿司匹林 ASA：嚼碎吞下
steps.subEn: unless it was already taken before you arrived
steps.subZh: 你到之前已经吃过就不再给

steps.subEn: now if you can; if not, the crew prepares the way out
steps.subZh: 能走就马上走；走不了就让队友先准备撤离路线

steps.zh: 问病史，测基线生命体征
steps.subEn: with a pain assessment

steps.zh: 合适就给硝酸甘油 nitroglycerin
steps.subEn: transport after the first dose, if you are not moving yet
steps.subZh: 还没出发的话，第一剂后就走

items.en: it was completely gone for over 5 minutes: restart the nitroglycerin, not the ASA
items.zh: 完全不痛超过 5 分钟后又痛：重新给硝酸甘油，不再给阿司匹林

items.en: still pain after 3 doses, or systolic under 110 mmHg: Entonox, 5 minutes after the last nitroglycerin
items.zh: 三剂后还痛，或收缩压 < 110 mmHg：最后一剂硝酸甘油 5 分钟后给 Entonox（笑气-氧气混合气）

items.en: after the first nitroglycerin the protocol may be repeated, once the nitrous oxide has been off for 5 minutes
items.zh: 第一剂硝酸甘油 30 分钟后可以重复本流程，先停笑气 5 分钟

items.en: Assessment, treatment and vitals every 5 minutes.
items.zh: 评估、处置、生命体征每 5 分钟一次。

items.en: Repeat the ASA, even when the pain comes back.
items.zh: 再给一次阿司匹林，哪怕胸痛又回来。

items.en: Give nitroglycerin before a baseline set of vitals and a pain assessment.
items.zh: 没测基线生命体征、没做疼痛评估就给硝酸甘油。

items.en: Vascular access, with running intravenous fluid.
items.zh: 建立静脉通路，挂上液体。

items.en: Consider dimenhydrinate for nausea.
items.zh: 恶心：考虑茶苯海明（dimenhydrinate）。

quiz.qEn: A man with crushing chest pain chewed his own ASA ten minutes before you arrived. Do you give ASA?
quiz.qZh: 一名胸口压榨样疼痛的男子，在你到之前十分钟已经自己嚼服了阿司匹林（ASA）。你还给吗？
quiz.whyEn: ASA is given if it was not already taken before EHS arrived.
quiz.whyZh: 你到之前没吃过，才给阿司匹林。

quiz.qEn: She has had three doses of nitroglycerin and still has pain. What is next?
quiz.qZh: 她已经用了三剂硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin），还在痛。下一步？

opts.en: Entonox, 5 minutes after the last nitroglycerin
opts.zh: 最后一剂硝酸甘油 5 分钟后给 Entonox

quiz.whyEn: Pain beyond 3 doses, or a systolic under 110 mmHg: Entonox 5 minutes after the last dose of nitroglycerin.
quiz.whyZh: 三剂后还痛，或收缩压 < 110 mmHg：最后一剂硝酸甘油 5 分钟后给 Entonox（笑气-氧气混合气）。

quiz.qEn: His pain went away completely for ten minutes. Now it is back. What do you restart?
quiz.qZh: 他的胸痛完全消失了十分钟，现在又痛了。重新开始什么？

opts.zh: 阿司匹林和硝酸甘油都重新给
硝酸甘油，不给阿司匹林

quiz.whyEn: Completely relieved for more than 5 minutes and then back: the nitroglycerin component may be restarted, never the ASA.
quiz.whyZh: 完全缓解超过 5 分钟后又痛：可以重新开始硝酸甘油部分，阿司匹林不再给。

quiz.qEn: After one nitroglycerin her systolic pressure is 104 mmHg and she still has pain. What now?
quiz.qZh: 用了一剂硝酸甘油后，她的收缩压是 104 mmHg，还在痛。现在怎么办？

opts.zh: 那一剂 5 分钟后给 Entonox

quiz.whyEn: A systolic pressure under 110 mmHg ends the nitroglycerin. Entonox follows 5 minutes after the last dose.
quiz.whyZh: 收缩压 < 110 mmHg 就不再给硝酸甘油。最后一剂 5 分钟后改用 Entonox（笑气-氧气混合气）。

nausea-vomiting.headZh: 稳定：|现场给药。|不稳定：路上给。
nausea-vomiting.lineEn: The airway comes first: position the patient and keep the suction ready.
nausea-vomiting.lineZh: 先护住气道：摆好体位，吸引器随时备用。

items.en: At rest, in a position of comfort that still protects the airway.
items.zh: 休息，摆一个舒服、同时能保护气道的体位。

items.en: Expect more vomiting: suction ready.
items.zh: 随时可能再吐：吸引器备好。

items.en: on scene
items.zh: 在现场给

items.en: en route to hospital
items.zh: 在去医院的路上给

items.en: Vascular access.
items.zh: 建立静脉通路。

items.en: Dimenhydrinate.
items.zh: 茶苯海明（dimenhydrinate）。

items.en: Ondansetron.
items.zh: 昂丹司琼（ondansetron）。

items.en: bolus, at most 2 litres
items.zh: 补液，最多 2 升

items.en: reassess every
items.zh: 每补这么多复查一次

items.en: target systolic, mmHg
items.zh: 目标收缩压 mmHg

quiz.qEn: A stable woman has been vomiting all morning. Where does she get her anti-emetic?
quiz.qZh: 一名情况稳定的女子吐了一上午。止吐药在哪里给？
quiz.whyEn: Stable patients may be treated with anti-emetics on scene. Unstable patients are treated en route.
quiz.whyZh: 稳定的病人可以在现场给止吐药。不稳定的在路上给。

quiz.qEn: He is hypotensive from fluid loss and you are giving fluid. What systolic pressure are you aiming for?
quiz.qZh: 他因为失液而低血压，你在补液。目标收缩压是多少？
quiz.whyEn: Reassess after every bolus. The target systolic pressure is 90 mmHg.
quiz.whyZh: 每次补液后复查。目标收缩压 90 mmHg。

quiz.qEn: The bolus is running. How often do you reassess?
quiz.qZh: 正在补液。多久复查一次？
quiz.whyEn: 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml.
quiz.whyZh: 20 ml/kg，最多 2 升，每 500 ml 复查一次。

sob-asthma-copd.lineEn: Transport after the first dose. The target is SpO₂ 94%, and it may not be reachable.
sob-asthma-copd.lineZh: 给了第一剂沙丁胺醇（salbutamol）就转运。SpO₂ 目标 94%，但不一定达得到。

steps.subEn: usually seated, leaning forward · little movement
steps.subZh: 通常是坐着、身体前倾 · 尽量少动

steps.subEn: oxygen for SpO₂ of 94% or more
now if you can; if not, the crew prepares the way out
steps.subZh: 能走就马上走；走不了就让队友先准备撤离路线

steps.zh: 问病史，测基线生命体征

steps.subEn: nebulizer or MDI · transport after the first dose
steps.subZh: 雾化或 MDI · 第一剂后就走

blocks.titleEn: Which way the salbutamol goes in

items.en: Flu-like or other infectious breathing illness: MDI with a spacer is strongly recommended.
items.zh: 有流感样症状或其他呼吸道传染病：强烈建议用 MDI 加储雾罐（spacer）。

items.en: A ventilated patient: MDI through the side port of the bag-valve mask.
items.zh: 正在通气的病人：从球囊面罩的侧孔给 MDI。

blocks.titleEn: Oxygen, one step at a time

steps.subEn: up to 15 L/min, for SpO₂ 94%

steps.zh: 换非重复呼吸面罩，15 L/min

steps.subEn: also at 15 L/min
PCP
with PEEP for PCPs · record the SpO₂ changes
steps.subZh: PCP 加 PEEP · 记录 SpO₂ 的变化

items.en: an adult face mask never runs below this
items.zh: 成人面罩不能低于这个流量

items.en: COPD by nasal cannula, after the acute treatment
items.zh: COPD 用鼻导管，在急性期处理之后

items.en: non-rebreather for carbon monoxide poisoning and smoke inhalation
items.zh: 一氧化碳中毒、吸入烟雾：用非重复呼吸面罩

items.en: A COPD patient who is short of breath does get high-flow oxygen.
items.zh: COPD 病人只要喊气短，就要给高流量氧。

items.en: Not short of breath and not in shock: titrate by the oximeter, aiming for 94%.
items.zh: 不气短、没有休克：按血氧仪调，目标 94%。

items.en: Short of breath, in shock, or carbon monoxide poisoning: high-flow oxygen.
items.zh: 气短、休克、一氧化碳中毒：高流量氧。

items.en: Run an adult face mask below 6 L/min. It delivers less oxygen than room air.
items.zh: 成人面罩流量低于 6 L/min。这样给的氧比空气还少。

items.en: Salbutamol with ipratropium in the same nebulizer. Ipratropium is given once; salbutamol may be repeated.
items.zh: 沙丁胺醇加异丙托溴铵（ipratropium）放同一个雾化器。异丙托溴铵只给一次，沙丁胺醇可以重复。

items.en: Severe disease or respiratory failure about to happen: epinephrine IM.
items.zh: 病情严重或即将呼吸衰竭：肌注肾上腺素（epinephrine）。

items.en: Consider epinephrine IM when SpO₂ is under 90%, and/or moderate to severe bronchospasm has not settled with salbutamol.
items.zh: SpO₂ < 90%，和/或沙丁胺醇后中重度支气管痉挛仍不缓解：考虑肌注肾上腺素。

items.en: Consider dexamethasone. Consider CPAP.
items.zh: 考虑地塞米松（dexamethasone）。考虑 CPAP。

quiz.qEn: A man with COPD says he cannot get his breath. SpO₂ 86%. What oxygen does he get?
quiz.qZh: 一名 COPD 男子说喘不上气，SpO₂ 86%。给他怎么吸氧？
quiz.whyEn: High-flow oxygen is indicated for COPD patients complaining of shortness of breath. The 1–3 L/min by cannula comes after the acute treatment.
quiz.whyZh: COPD 病人喊气短就给高流量氧。鼻导管 1–3 L/min 是急性期处理之后的事。

quiz.qEn: Your partner sets an adult face mask to 4 L/min. Is that acceptable?
quiz.qZh: 搭档把成人面罩的流量调到 4 L/min。可以吗？
quiz.whyEn: An adult face mask below 6 L/min delivers less oxygen than room air.
quiz.whyZh: 成人面罩低于 6 L/min，给的氧比空气还少。

quiz.qEn: A wheezy woman with asthma also has a fever and a cough, like the flu. How do you give the salbutamol?
quiz.qZh: 一名哮喘女子在喘，同时发烧、咳嗽，像流感。沙丁胺醇怎么给？
quiz.whyEn: MDI and spacer use is strongly recommended with signs of influenza-like illness or other infectious respiratory conditions.
quiz.whyZh: 有流感样表现或其他呼吸道传染病时，强烈建议用 MDI 加储雾罐。

quiz.qEn: The first nebulizer held salbutamol and ipratropium. He needs another. What goes in?
quiz.qZh: 第一次雾化放了沙丁胺醇（salbutamol）和异丙托溴铵（ipratropium）。他还需要一次。这次放什么？
quiz.whyEn: Ipratropium is a single dose. Salbutamol may be repeated.
quiz.whyZh: 异丙托溴铵只给一剂。沙丁胺醇可以重复。

hypovolemia.lineEn: The protocol asks for all three: hypovolemia, a systolic under 90 and other signs of shock.
hypovolemia.lineZh: 启用条件三条都要有：低血容量、收缩压 < 90、还有其他休克表现。

items.en: evidence of a significant loss of blood or body fluids
items.zh: 有证据显示大量失血或失液

items.en: systolic pressure, mmHg
items.zh: 收缩压 mmHg

items.en: other clinical signs or symptoms of shock
items.zh: 其他休克的表现

items.en: Burns over 20% BSA, partial and full thickness.
items.zh: > 20% BSA 的烧伤（部分皮层和全层烧伤）。

items.en: Pressure above 90, but shock is anticipated from the mechanism, the injuries or the patient's condition.
items.zh: 血压高于 90，但从受伤机制、伤情或病人状况看，预计会休克。

steps.subEn: if clinically indicated
to support the blood pressure

steps.en: Oxygen to keep SpO₂ at 94% or more

blocks.titleEn: On the way, or when delayed

items.en: Vascular access.
items.zh: 建立静脉通路。

items.en: Consider a fluid bolus for hypoperfusion or hypotension: 20 ml/kg, at most 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml.
items.zh: 低灌注或低血压，考虑补液：20 ml/kg，最多 2 升，每 500 ml 复查一次。

items.en: Consider TXA (tranexamic acid) for shock from blood loss, and for hypovolemia from occult bleeding.
items.zh: 失血性休克，或隐匿出血造成的低血容量：考虑 TXA 氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid）。

quiz.qEn: A man fell from a roof. Pelvic pain, pale, heart rate 124, pressure 108/70. Do you use the hypovolemia protocol?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子从屋顶摔下。骨盆痛、面色苍白，心率 124，血压 108/70。启用低血容量流程吗？
quiz.whyEn: The protocol may be used above 90 mmHg when shock is anticipated from the mechanism, the injuries or the patient's condition.
quiz.whyZh: 从受伤机制、伤情或病人状况预计会休克时，血压高于 90 也可以启用。

quiz.qEn: How do you position a hypovolemic patient?
quiz.qZh: 低血容量的病人怎么摆体位？
quiz.whyEn: Supine, to support the blood pressure.
quiz.whyZh: 仰卧，帮助维持血压。

quiz.qEn: A woman has partial and full thickness burns over 25% of her body. Pressure 118/76. Does she qualify?
quiz.qZh: 一名女子部分和全层烧伤面积 25%。血压 118/76。符合启用条件吗？
quiz.whyEn: Patients with burns over 20% BSA, partial and full thickness, are an indication on their own.
quiz.whyZh: 部分和全层烧伤超过 20% BSA，本身就是启用条件。

quiz.qEn: You decide on a fluid bolus. How much, and how do you run it?
quiz.qZh: 你决定补液。补多少，怎么补？

opts.en: 20 ml/kg, at most 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml
opts.zh: 20 ml/kg，最多 2 升，每 500 ml 复查一次

quiz.whyEn: 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml.
quiz.whyZh: 20 ml/kg，最多 2 升，每 500 ml 复查一次。

anaphylaxis.lineEn: An allergen, the signs, and an unstable patient: that is the protocol.
anaphylaxis.lineZh: 接触了过敏原 + 有过敏表现 + 病人不稳定 = 启用流程。

items.en: exposure to an allergen
items.zh: 接触过敏原

items.en: breathing (short of breath, wheeze, cough, stridor) · gut (nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, pain) · hives · swelling · low pressure
items.zh: 呼吸（气短、喘鸣、咳嗽、喉鸣）· 胃肠（恶心、呕吐、腹泻、腹痛）· 荨麻疹 · 血管性水肿 · 低血压

items.en: syncope, decreased LOC, pressure under 90 mmHg, or respiratory distress
items.zh: 晕厥、意识下降、血压 < 90 mmHg，或呼吸窘迫

steps.en: Supine. Do not walk the patient

steps.subEn: scrape off the stinger · stop the drug
airway, and oxygen for SpO₂ of 94% or more

steps.en: The crew prepares the way out

steps.zh: 问病史，测基线生命体征

steps.en: Transport, and carry on en route
steps.zh: 转运，路上继续评估和处置

items.en: Stand the patient up or walk them.
items.zh: 让病人站起来或自己走。

items.en: Still hypotensive or hypoperfused: vascular access and fluid. Fluid bolus 20 ml/kg, at most 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml.
items.zh: 仍然低血压或低灌注：建立静脉通路并补液。补液 20 ml/kg，最多 2 升，每 500 ml 复查一次。

items.en: Bronchospasm: salbutamol, after the epinephrine.
items.zh: 支气管痉挛：给沙丁胺醇（salbutamol），要在肾上腺素之后。

items.en: Diphenhydramine, for the medium-term effects and to limit the histamine response.
items.zh: 苯海拉明（diphenhydramine）：减轻中期反应，抑制组胺反应。

quiz.qEn: A man was stung by a bee. Hives, wheezing, pressure 84/50. He wants to walk to the ambulance. What do you do?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子被蜜蜂蜇了。全身荨麻疹、喘，血压 84/50。他想自己走去救护车。你怎么做？

opts.en: Lay him flat and carry him
Sit him up and walk beside him

quiz.whyEn: Position supine to improve the blood pressure, and do not walk the patient.
quiz.whyZh: 仰卧帮助血压回升，不让病人走。

quiz.qEn: The stinger is still in his arm. What do you do with it?
quiz.qZh: 毒刺还留在他手臂上。怎么处理？
quiz.whyEn: Remove the allergen: scrape off any stinger, or stop the drug.
quiz.whyZh: 去掉过敏原：刮掉毒刺，或停止用药。

quiz.qEn: Which drug does the anaphylaxis protocol give at every licence level?
quiz.qZh: 过敏性休克流程里，所有级别都给的药是哪个？
quiz.whyEn: Epinephrine is in the interventions for all licence levels. Salbutamol and diphenhydramine are PCP additions.
quiz.whyZh: 肾上腺素在所有级别的处置里。沙丁胺醇和苯海拉明是 PCP 另加的。

quiz.qEn: She is still wheezing after the sting. When does the salbutamol go in?
quiz.qZh: 被蜇之后她还在喘。沙丁胺醇（salbutamol）什么时候给？
quiz.whyEn: Bronchospasm is treated with salbutamol after epinephrine has been administered.
quiz.whyZh: 给了肾上腺素之后，再用沙丁胺醇处理支气管痉挛。

narcotic-overdose.lineEn: A low LOC with slow, shallow breathing. Check the sugar as well.
narcotic-overdose.lineZh: 意识差，加上呼吸又慢又浅。血糖也要查。

items.en: decreased level of consciousness
items.zh: 意识水平下降

items.en: a slow rate and a small tidal volume
items.zh: 呼吸频率慢，而且潮气量小

blocks.titleEn: Other signs of an opioid overdose
blocks.titleZh: 阿片类过量的其他表现

items.en: Pinpoint pupils (miosis).
items.zh: 针尖样瞳孔（miosis）。

items.en: Hypotension.
items.zh: 低血压。

items.en: Hypothermia.
items.zh: 低体温。

items.en: Tachycardia.
items.zh: 心动过速。

steps.subEn: positioning · suction · an adjunct as needed
steps.subZh: 摆体位 · 吸引 · 需要时放气道辅助器

steps.subEn: consider a two-person bag-valve mask

steps.en: Oxygen to keep SpO₂ at 94% or more

steps.zh: 问病史，测基线生命体征
steps.subEn: with a blood glucose

steps.en: Glucose 4 mmol/L or less: correct it
Transport, and carry on en route
steps.zh: 转运，路上继续评估和处置

items.en: Decide on naloxone from the LOC alone. Look at the rate and the tidal volume too.
items.zh: 只凭意识水平就决定给纳洛酮。还要看呼吸频率和潮气量。

items.en: Still unconscious and not breathing: vascular access, and naloxone intravenously.
items.zh: 仍然昏迷、没有呼吸：建立静脉通路，静脉给纳洛酮。

quiz.qEn: A man is unresponsive, breathing 4 times a minute and shallowly, with pinpoint pupils. What comes first?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子没有反应，每分钟呼吸 4 次、很浅，针尖样瞳孔。先做什么？

opts.en: Open the airway and ventilate him

quiz.whyEn: The primary survey comes first: airway, then supported ventilations and oxygen. The vitals and the naloxone follow.
quiz.whyZh: 先做 primary survey：气道、辅助通气、给氧。然后才是生命体征和纳洛酮。

quiz.qEn: His blood glucose comes back at 3.2 mmol/L. What do you do with that?
quiz.qZh: 他的血糖是 3.2 mmol/L。怎么处理？

opts.en: Ignore it: this is an opioid call

quiz.whyEn: A blood glucose of 4 mmol/L or less is corrected.
quiz.whyZh: 血糖 ≤ 4 mmol/L 要纠正。

quiz.qEn: A woman is drowsy after taking pills. She breathes 16 times a minute with good volume. Does she fit this protocol?
quiz.qZh: 一名女子吃药后犯困。呼吸每分钟 16 次，潮气量正常。符合这个流程吗？

opts.en: No: her breathing is not depressed
opts.zh: 不符合：呼吸没有受抑制

quiz.whyEn: The indication is a decreased LOC together with a depressed respiratory drive: a low rate and a limited tidal volume.
quiz.whyZh: 启用条件是意识下降，同时呼吸驱动受抑制：频率慢、潮气量小。

diabetic-emergencies.headEn: Below 4.0: |gel only if they can |protect the airway.
diabetic-emergencies.headZh: 血糖低于 4.0：|护得住气道|才给凝胶。
diabetic-emergencies.lineEn: A low LOC with no known cause always gets a blood glucose. Look for stroke signs too.
diabetic-emergencies.lineZh: 意识下降又原因不明，一定要查血糖。还要看有没有卒中表现。

items.en: enough mentation to keep the airway: glucose gel on the oral mucosa
items.zh: 神志足以护住气道：葡萄糖凝胶（glucose gel）涂在口腔黏膜上

items.en: insufficient mentation or an unprotected airway: an EMR gives glucagon; a PCP goes to the IV first
items.zh: 神志不够，或气道没有保护：EMR 给胰高血糖素（glucagon）；PCP 先开静脉

steps.subEn: positioning · suction · an adjunct as needed
steps.subZh: 摆体位 · 吸引 · 需要时放气道辅助器

steps.en: Oxygen to keep SpO₂ at 94% or more
Lateral or three-quarter prone, if needed
steps.zh: 需要的话侧卧或 3/4 俯卧

steps.en: The crew prepares the way out

steps.zh: 问病史，测基线生命体征
steps.subEn: with a blood glucose

steps.en: Look for stroke signs and symptoms

steps.subEn: glucose under 4.0 mmol/L

items.en: Put glucose gel in the mouth of a patient who cannot protect the airway.
items.zh: 给护不住气道的病人往嘴里涂葡萄糖凝胶。

items.en: 10–25 g, which is 100–250 ml of the 10% solution, for confirmed hypoglycemia
items.zh: 确认低血糖：10–25 g，也就是 10% 葡萄糖（D10W）100–250 ml

items.en: glucagon
items.zh: 开不了静脉：给胰高血糖素（glucagon）

items.en: Transport after the first bolus of D10W, or after the glucagon, and carry on en route.
items.zh: 第一剂 D10W 或胰高血糖素给完就转运，路上继续评估和处置。

quiz.qEn: A known diabetic is confused but talking, and swallows when asked. Glucose 2.9 mmol/L. What do you give?
quiz.qZh: 一名糖尿病病人神志有些混乱，但能说话，让他吞咽他能做到。血糖 2.9 mmol/L。给什么？

opts.en: Glucose gel on the oral mucosa
opts.zh: 葡萄糖凝胶，涂口腔黏膜

opts.en: Nothing by mouth: wait for the hospital
opts.zh: 什么都不经口给，等到医院

quiz.whyEn: With enough mentation to maintain an airway, glucose gel goes on the oral mucosa.
quiz.whyZh: 神志足以护住气道的病人，把葡萄糖凝胶涂在口腔黏膜上。

quiz.qEn: A woman is unresponsive and snoring. Glucose 2.1 mmol/L. No IV is possible. What do you give?
quiz.qZh: 一名女子没有反应、打鼾样呼吸。血糖 2.1 mmol/L。开不了静脉。给什么？

opts.zh: 把葡萄糖凝胶涂在她的颊内

quiz.whyEn: Insufficient mentation or an unprotected airway: glucagon. A PCP uses it when IV access cannot be obtained.
quiz.whyZh: 神志不够或气道没有保护：给胰高血糖素。PCP 在开不了静脉时用它。

quiz.qEn: A man has a low LOC. His glucose is 6.2 mmol/L and one arm is weak. What do you look for?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子意识下降。血糖 6.2 mmol/L，一侧手臂无力。你要评估什么？

opts.en: Nothing more: the sugar is normal
A reason to give glucagon anyway
opts.zh: 找理由照样给胰高血糖素

quiz.whyEn: Every patient on this page is evaluated for stroke signs and symptoms.
quiz.whyZh: 这一页的每个病人都要评估有没有卒中表现。

quiz.qEn: The IV is in and the hypoglycemia is confirmed. How much D10W?
quiz.qZh: 静脉通路开好了，低血糖也确认了。D10W（10% 葡萄糖）给多少？
quiz.whyEn: D10W 10–25 g: 100–250 ml of the 10% solution.
